page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-16 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance featuring 16 vCPUs and 62 GB of RAM. Powered by an AMD EPYC 9B45 processor with x86_64 architecture, this server allocates 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core on a dedicated basis. The CPU cache configuration includes 48 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. It lacks local NVMe SSD storage and does not include any bundled GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

In benchmark evaluations, the c4d-standard-16 demonstrates top-tier single-core CPU performance, as evidenced by its stress-ng single-core score and high single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression rates. Multi-core performance, including stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU scores, falls within the average tier. Memory performance is strong, with PassMark memory scores ranking in the top 25%, while uncached memory read and write bandwidths remain average.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated AMD EPYC hardware provides a balanced resource density for workloads requiring reliable single-thread execution without the premium of GPU acceleration or local storage. The instance is well-suited for general-purpose workloads, web serving, database operations, and single-threaded data processing tasks such as compression and decompression.
